# add

Add file contents to the index.

## JavaScript

```ts
git.add({ all?: boolean, dryRun?: boolean, paths: string[] })
```

## CLI

```bash
git --no-pager add [--all] [--dry-run] <paths>...
```

## Parameters

| Parameter | CLI | Type | Required | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `all` | `--all` | `boolean` | No | - | Stage every change, including deletions. |
| `dryRun` | `--dry-run` | `boolean` | No | - | Report what would be staged without staging it. |
| `paths` | _positional_ | `string[]` | Yes | - | Paths to stage. |

## Examples

**Stage two files**

```ts
await git.add({
  paths: ['README.md', 'src/index.ts'],
})
```

```bash
git --no-pager add README.md src/index.ts
```
